terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: These terms explain how Aura Liberia works for customers, merchants, listing owners and riders. Read them before placing an order, arranging a service or publishing content.

sections.title: 1. About Aura
paragraphs: Aura connects people with kitchens, grocery shops, Lifestyle sellers, property and vehicle advertisers, and available riders. The seller or service provider identified on a listing is responsible for its goods, descriptions and fulfilment. Aura provides the platform and the features described in the app; a business approval badge does not guarantee a product, property, vehicle or transaction.

sections.title: 2. Your account and eligibility
paragraphs: You must be at least 18, or otherwise legally able to enter the transaction, to place orders, host a live broadcast or operate a business workspace. Keep your account details accurate and protect your sign-in methods. Use only accounts and business workspaces you are authorised to access. Let us know if you believe your account has been misused.

sections.title: 3. Orders, prices and availability
paragraphs: Review the items, quantities, options, delivery address, phone number, fulfilment method and displayed total before submitting. Stock and prices can change; the platform may require you to review a new total. A submitted order is subject to the relevant business accepting and being able to fulfil it.

Food and groceries support ordering and fulfilment. Ordinary Lifestyle checkout sends an order request to each seller through chat; the seller confirms availability, delivery and payment. Homes and Motors are listing and contact services, not a platform property or vehicle checkout. Verify ownership, condition and transaction details before paying or entering an agreement.

sections.title: 4. Payments and Live Market receipts
paragraphs: Only use the payment methods shown for your order. Where a merchant asks for a direct MoMo payment, confirm the recipient name, number, amount and reference before sending money. Aura does not collect that direct merchant payment.

For Live Market, upload a cropped payment receipt showing only the relevant payment message. Receipt upload is not proof that funds arrived and does not automatically confirm payment. The merchant verifies its account and accepts or rejects the receipt. Do not upload another person’s receipt, altered evidence, account balances or unrelated private messages.

sections.title: 5. Delivery, pickup and dine-in
paragraphs: Provide a reachable phone number and an accurate location or landmark. Businesses may use their own registered delivery personnel. Delivery times, driver search countdowns and travel estimates are estimates, not guarantees.

For dine-in, confirm your selected restaurant and table. GPS-based restaurant and table suggestions may be inaccurate and do not prove a table is available or that you occupy it. Tell the kitchen if a suggested table is wrong.

sections.title: 6. Rides
paragraphs: A ride request may be offered sequentially to available drivers. A driver can decline or propose a price. Review and confirm the proposed price before the trip proceeds. Search may time out without a driver; you can stop or continue when the app offers that choice.

Location and route information may be incomplete or delayed. Follow local road and safety requirements, verify the driver and vehicle, and use local emergency services in an emergency. Aura is not an emergency-response service.

sections.title: 7. Cancellations, missing items and disputes
paragraphs: Use the cancellation controls when available. If an order is already being prepared, collected or delivered, contact the business to discuss the available options. The app may prevent cancellation after payment evidence or a confirmed direct payment so the merchant can resolve it with you.

Report missing, incorrect, unsafe or undelivered items promptly to the business through its listing or order contact options. Refunds for money paid directly to a merchant must be arranged with that merchant; Aura does not promise an automatic refund or a fixed processing time. Any applicable consumer rights continue to apply.

sections.title: 8. Businesses, listings and promotions
paragraphs: Business operators must have authority to represent their business, provide accurate contact and location details, maintain required permissions and licences, and keep prices, stock and listing descriptions current. Assign only authorised team members and registered riders; do not share private customer details for unrelated purposes.

Only offer lawful goods and services that you have authority to sell or advertise. Promotions must use a genuine regular price and clear offer dates and conditions. Do not mislead buyers with fabricated discounts, reviews, engagement or payment claims. Aura may request changes, reject, suspend or remove businesses or content that violate these terms or create a safety or fraud concern.

sections.title: 9. Messages, uploads and broadcasts
paragraphs: Upload or broadcast only material you have the right to share, including consent from identifiable people where required. Do not post harassment, scams, unlawful goods, infringement, private information or harmful content. A public live broadcast, its comments and its featured products can be seen by other viewers.

You keep rights you hold in your content and allow Aura and its service providers to store, process, format and display it as needed to operate the features you use. Configured live replays normally leave the public feed 12 hours after the broadcast ends. Removal from the feed does not mean immediate deletion from storage, backups, orders or dispute records. Do not assume paid replay retention is available unless it is explicitly offered with its price and duration.

sections.title: 10. Availability and responsibility
paragraphs: We aim to keep Aura reliable, but cannot guarantee uninterrupted service, accurate GPS, delivery estimates, third-party networks, seller performance or that every listing remains available. No service is completely secure. You are responsible for checking important transaction details and using the platform lawfully.

Nothing in these terms excludes liability, remedies or rights that cannot lawfully be excluded. If an issue arises, contact the relevant business first for its transaction and use Aura’s confirmed support contact for platform issues.

sections.title: 11. Changes and contact
paragraphs: We may update these terms as the service changes. The updated date appears at the top of this page. Material changes will be communicated through the platform where appropriate; a revised page does not represent consent to a new paid service.
Questions about these terms can be sent to the confirmed operator contact below.

sections.title: Events and Community
paragraphs: Organisers are responsible for event descriptions, dates, venue access and admission instructions. Events and Community submissions may be reviewed, returned for changes or removed. An Aura registration records attendance information; it does not verify a payment or guarantee paid admission. External registration websites operate under their own terms. Post only content you have permission to share, and use the reporting action for concerns.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains the information used by Aura Liberia’s web and mobile features, who receives it and the choices available to you. It covers the services you use, not every optional feature at all times.

sections.title: 1. Information we process
paragraphs: Account information can include your user ID, name, email address, verified phone number and sign-in provider information. We process delivery contacts, addresses, coordinates, order details, selected options, prices, timestamps and fulfilment updates when you use those features.

Listings and business profiles can include contact details, business locations, uploaded images and video, stock, promotions, team associations and application-review records. Messages can include text, images, video, recorded voice notes, catalogue references and read state.

Live Market can process broadcasts and configured recordings, comments, likes, featured items, order references, merchant MoMo details and private payment receipts. Ride and delivery features can process pickup and destination information, vehicle and driver details, availability and location updates.

Our infrastructure and providers may process IP addresses, device/browser information, request logs, security events and notification registration identifiers to operate, protect and troubleshoot the service. Do not include information unrelated to the transaction in messages or uploads.

sections.title: 2. How we use information
paragraphs: We use information to sign you in, connect you with businesses and riders, create and track orders, route messages, verify merchant-submitted payment decisions, manage business access, deliver notifications and prevent misuse. We also use relevant records to resolve disputes, enforce platform rules and meet applicable obligations.

Food recommendations can use completed orders associated with your account to suggest similar available meals and familiar extras at another kitchen. The recommendations use matching rules; they do not require an AI service. You can pause learning or forget learned preferences in your account. This does not delete order records.

sections.title: 3. Location, camera and microphone
paragraphs: With permission, location helps suggest a delivery address, nearby restaurant, route or dine-in table. A delivery-location sheet may request your current location when opened. You can deny permission and use available search or manual options, and change permissions in your device or browser settings.

Online riders share location for availability, matching, navigation and delivery tracking. Web location sharing operates while the relevant page is open. Stop sharing by going offline and change device permissions if needed. Location fixes can be inaccurate; table suggestions require confirmation.

Camera and microphone access support live broadcasting and in-app voice recording when you choose those features. Selecting a file does not give the app access to all of your photos. Public broadcasting is visible to viewers; private chat attachments are restricted to authorised conversation participants.

sections.title: 4. Who can receive information
paragraphs: A business receives the contact, order, fulfilment and table information needed to serve its customer. Assigned delivery personnel receive the information needed to collect and deliver an order. Ride participants receive the relevant pickup, destination and confirmed driver contact details. Other candidate drivers are shown only limited discovery information.

Listing owners and conversation participants receive messages and the attachments you send them. Merchant payment recipients and authorised merchant staff can review receipts for their orders. Platform administrators can review business applications and relevant operational records for authorised administration and safety work.

Your published listings, public business details, live broadcasts, comments and engagement may be visible to other users. A live order or payment announcement may reference the buyer’s first name only when the corresponding sharing option is used; avoid disclosing private customer details during a broadcast.

We use providers such as Google/Firebase for sign-in, data/storage and messaging, Google Maps Platform for place searches and routes, LiveKit for configured live broadcasting, and hosting providers for web/backend delivery. We may disclose information when required by applicable law or to address fraud, security or safety concerns.

sections.title: 5. Payment information
paragraphs: Direct MoMo payments are made to the merchant through the payment provider, not collected by Aura. Aura stores the order reference, recipient details, uploaded receipt and merchant review decision needed for the manual workflow. A receipt may contain personal or transaction information: crop it to the relevant payment message and leave out balances and unrelated messages. Never share PINs, passwords or verification codes.

sections.title: 6. Storage and retention
paragraphs: We retain account and operational information for as long as needed to provide the service and address security, dispute, accounting or legal requirements. Different records have different needs; this policy does not promise a single deletion deadline for all information.

Configured live replays normally stop appearing publicly 12 hours after a broadcast ends. Recording cleanup runs separately; private storage, backup or transaction records may remain longer. Payment receipts and chat media do not become public replay content.

Data can be processed outside Liberia by our service providers. Provider processing locations and retention practices vary by service. We use access controls and other safeguards, but cannot guarantee that any transmission or storage system is completely secure.

sections.title: 7. Your controls and requests
paragraphs: You can update saved delivery information, manage saved items, pause or clear food-preference learning, sign out, and change location, camera, microphone and notification permissions. In-app operational updates may remain available even when device push permission is off.

Use the confirmed privacy contact below to request access, correction, account/data deletion or raise a privacy concern. We may need to verify your identity and may retain records where necessary for legitimate disputes, safety or applicable obligations. Signing out, deleting the installed app or removing an item from Saved does not delete your account or transaction history.

sections.title: 8. Cookies and local storage
paragraphs: The web app and providers use browser storage and similar technologies for sign-in, baskets, preferences, notification registration and essential security. Offline caching is limited to suitable app resources; authenticated API responses and private media requests bypass the app’s offline cache. Clearing browser storage may sign you out or remove a locally saved basket.

sections.title: 9. Children and other people’s information
paragraphs: Aura’s transaction and business features are intended for adults able to enter the relevant transaction. Products advertised for children do not make the service a children’s account service. Do not submit a child’s personal information or another person’s private information without appropriate authority. Contact the privacy contact if you believe information was submitted improperly.

sections.title: 10. External services
paragraphs: Opening a phone call, WhatsApp conversation, external map or another service takes you to that provider’s service and privacy practices. Information you choose to send there is subject to that provider’s terms.

sections.title: 11. Policy updates and contact
paragraphs: We may update this policy when features or information practices change. The updated date is shown at the top. Important changes will be communicated through the platform where appropriate. Contact the confirmed operator below with questions or privacy requests.

sections.title: Events and Community
paragraphs: Event and Community posts, replies, organiser names and uploaded media are public after approval. Registration form answers are shared privately with the event organiser to manage attendance. Saved events, follows and registrations are associated with your account and used for event reminders and relevant updates. Reports are available to platform moderators. Do not submit passwords, payment PINs or other sensitive information through registration forms.
